quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Urban"? (a busy city full of tall buildings vs. a quiet farm surrounded by fields)
quests.hint: Think about where you'd expect to see more skyscrapers, a city or a farm. What's the opposite of "Urban"?
quests.explanation: "Urban" means relating to a busy city. "Rural" means relating to the quiet countryside. Since those are completely different, Rural is the opposite of Urban!
quests.funFact: A rural area is located far out in the quiet countryside.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Join"? (two magnets snapping together vs. two magnets pushed far apart)
quests.hint: Think about what happens when you push two magnets' matching ends close together. What's the opposite of "Join"?
quests.explanation: "Join" means to come together with others. "Separate" means to move apart from others. Since those are completely different, Separate is the opposite of Join!
quests.funFact: Oil and water will completely separate if you let them sit perfectly still.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Cautious"? (checking both ways before crossing vs. dashing across without looking)
quests.hint: Think about what a crossing guard teaches you to do at every corner. What's the opposite of "Cautious"?
quests.explanation: "Cautious" means careful to avoid danger. "Reckless" means careless about danger. Since those are completely different, Reckless is the opposite of Cautious!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: reckless is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Vacant"? (an empty seat with no one sitting in it vs. a seat with someone already there)
quests.hint: Think about the sign on a bathroom door that tells you it's free to use. What's the opposite of "Vacant"?
quests.explanation: "Vacant" means empty, with no one using it. "Occupied" means in use, with someone there. Since those are completely different, Occupied is the opposite of Vacant!
quests.funFact: An occupied bathroom usually has a locked door for privacy.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Fiction"? (a storybook about a talking dragon vs. a book packed with real facts about dinosaurs)
quests.hint: Think about which shelf at the library holds books about real ocean animals. What's the opposite of "Fiction"?
quests.explanation: "Fiction" means a made-up story from someone's imagination. "Nonfiction" means true information about the real world. Since those are completely different, Nonfiction is the opposite of Fiction!
quests.funFact: Nonfiction books are completely based on real facts and true events.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Appear"? (a rabbit popping out of a magician's hat vs. a coin vanishing from view)
quests.hint: Think about what a magician's rabbit does at the start of the trick. What's the opposite of "Appear"?
quests.explanation: "Appear" means to suddenly come into view. "Disappear" means to suddenly go out of view. Since those are completely different, Disappear is the opposite of Appear!
quests.funFact: A puddle of water will slowly disappear as it evaporates into the air.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Victory"? (a team hoisting a trophy overhead vs. a team walking off the field quietly)
quests.hint: Think about what the champions celebrate at the end of a tournament. What's the opposite of "Victory"?
quests.explanation: "Victory" means the happy result of winning a contest. "Defeat" means the disappointing result of not winning. Since those are completely different, Defeat is the opposite of Victory!
quests.funFact: A sports team will feel very sad if they suffer a massive defeat.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Fragile"? (an eggshell that cracks at the lightest tap vs. a steel beam that barely bends)
quests.hint: Think about which package would need a 'handle with care' sticker. What's the opposite of "Fragile"?
quests.explanation: "Fragile" means delicate and easy to break. "Sturdy" means strong and hard to break. Since those are completely different, Sturdy is the opposite of Fragile!
quests.funFact: A sturdy wooden table will not wobble when you lean heavily on it.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Simple"? (a four-piece toddler puzzle vs. a thousand-piece galaxy puzzle)
quests.hint: Think about which recipe has three steps and which one has thirty. What's the opposite of "Simple"?
quests.explanation: "Simple" means easy to understand, with few parts. "Complicated" means hard to understand, with many parts. Since those are completely different, Complicated is the opposite of Simple!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: complicated is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Ancient"? (a crumbling old stone temple vs. a shiny glass skyscraper)
quests.hint: Think about which building would have a smartphone charger inside it. What's the opposite of "Ancient"?
quests.explanation: "Ancient" means built a very long time ago. "Modern" means built recently, using the newest ideas. Since those are completely different, Modern is the opposite of Ancient!
quests.funFact: A modern smartphone is millions of times faster than early computers.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Abundant"? (a farm field overflowing with wheat vs. a dry patch with only a few stalks)
quests.hint: Think about how much water there is in a rainforest compared to a desert. What's the opposite of "Abundant"?
quests.explanation: "Abundant" means plentiful, with a lot available. "Scarce" means rare, with very little available. Since those are completely different, Scarce is the opposite of Abundant!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: scarce is an interesting opposite word!

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Humble"? (quietly saying 'we all worked hard' vs. boasting loudly about winning alone)
quests.hint: Think about how a kind champion often talks about their teammates after winning. What's the opposite of "Humble"?
quests.explanation: "Humble" means modest, not boasting about yourself. "Proud" means feeling very pleased with your own achievement. Since those are completely different, Proud is the opposite of Humble!
quests.funFact: A peacock flashes its massive, beautiful tail feathers to look proud.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Connect"? (plugging a charger snugly into an outlet vs. yanking the cord back out)
quests.hint: Think about what you do to your headphones before you can listen to music. What's the opposite of "Connect"?
quests.explanation: "Connect" means to join two things together. "Disconnect" means to pull two things apart. Since those are completely different, Disconnect is the opposite of Connect!
quests.funFact: You must disconnect a toaster from the wall before trying to clean it.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Construct"? (cranes stacking beams to build a tower vs. a wrecking ball knocking an old wall down)
quests.hint: Think about what workers do with cranes and bricks on a busy building site. What's the opposite of "Construct"?
quests.explanation: "Construct" means to build something new. "Demolish" means to knock something old down. Since those are completely different, Demolish is the opposite of Construct!
quests.funFact: A massive wrecking ball is used to completely demolish old concrete buildings.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Expand"? (a balloon growing bigger with every breath vs. a popped balloon crumpling small)
quests.hint: Think about what a balloon does as you blow more air inside it. What's the opposite of "Expand"?
quests.explanation: "Expand" means to grow larger in size. "Shrink" means to become smaller in size. Since those are completely different, Shrink is the opposite of Expand!
quests.funFact: A wool sweater will drastically shrink if you wash it in boiling hot water.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Interior"? (the cozy inside of a house vs. the painted outside walls)
quests.hint: Think about which part of a house you'd paint to change how it looks from the street. What's the opposite of "Interior"?
quests.explanation: "Interior" means the part on the inside of something. "Exterior" means the part on the outside of something. Since those are completely different, Exterior is the opposite of Interior!
quests.funFact: The exterior of a house is painted to protect the wood from the rain.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Ordinary"? (a plain Tuesday at school vs. your very own birthday party)
quests.hint: Think about how your birthday feels compared to a regular Wednesday. What's the opposite of "Ordinary"?
quests.explanation: "Ordinary" means normal, just like any other day. "Special" means unusual and important, unlike other days. Since those are completely different, Special is the opposite of Ordinary!
quests.funFact: A birthday is a special day to celebrate the exact day you were born.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Native"? (a language spoken at home since birth vs. a brand-new language learned at school)
quests.hint: Think about the language your family speaks at home, before you learn any others. What's the opposite of "Native"?
quests.explanation: "Native" means belonging naturally to a place. "Foreign" means coming from another place. Since those are completely different, Foreign is the opposite of Native!
quests.funFact: A foreign language has completely different words and grammar rules.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Vacant"? (an empty seat with no one sitting in it vs. a seat with someone already there)
quests.hint: Here's a clue: the sign on a bathroom door that tells you it's free to use. That describes the exact opposite of "Vacant"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: vacant means empty, with no one using it, and occupied means in use, with someone there — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: An occupied birdhouse has a family of birds living safely inside.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Save"? (dropping coins into a piggy bank vs. letting a faucet run with no one there)
quests.hint: Think about what a piggy bank helps you do with your allowance. What's the opposite of "Save"?
quests.explanation: "Save" means to keep something for later instead of using it up. "Waste" means to use something up without a good reason. Since those are completely different, Waste is the opposite of Save!
quests.funFact: Leaving the water running while you brush your teeth is a huge waste.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Permanent"? (a marker drawing that never washes off vs. chalk that rinses away in the rain)
quests.hint: Think about the kind of marker you would never want to use on a school wall. What's the opposite of "Permanent"?
quests.explanation: "Permanent" means lasting forever, without changing. "Temporary" means lasting only a short while. Since those are completely different, Temporary is the opposite of Permanent!
quests.funFact: A temporary tattoo washes completely off your skin with warm soap and water.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Join"? (two magnets snapping together vs. two magnets pushed far apart)
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what happens when you push two magnets' matching ends close together. That describes the exact opposite of "Join"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: join means to come together with others, and separate means to move apart from others — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: You must separate white clothes from red clothes before washing them.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Increase"? (a stack of coins growing taller vs. the same stack shrinking down)
quests.hint: Think about what happens to your savings jar every time you add a coin. What's the opposite of "Increase"?
quests.explanation: "Increase" means to become larger in amount. "Decrease" means to become smaller in amount. Since those are completely different, Decrease is the opposite of Increase!
quests.funFact: To decrease the temperature in a room, you turn on the air conditioner.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Visible"? (a rainbow stretched clearly across the sky vs. air you cannot see at all)
quests.hint: Think about whether you can actually see the air you're breathing. What's the opposite of "Visible"?
quests.explanation: "Visible" means able to be seen. "Invisible" means not able to be seen. Since those are completely different, Invisible is the opposite of Visible!
quests.funFact: The wind is completely invisible, but you can feel it push against you.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Appear"? (a rabbit popping out of a magician's hat vs. a coin vanishing from view)
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what a magician's rabbit does at the start of the trick. That describes the exact opposite of "Appear"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: appear means to suddenly come into view, and disappear means to suddenly go out of view — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Magicians use clever illusions to make objects seem to disappear.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Transparent"? (a clean glass window you can see straight through vs. a solid brick wall)
quests.hint: Think about which material lets sunlight pass straight into a room. What's the opposite of "Transparent"?
quests.explanation: "Transparent" means clear enough to see through. "Opaque" means solid, so you cannot see through it. Since those are completely different, Opaque is the opposite of Transparent!
quests.funFact: An opaque object completely blocks all light from passing through it.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Victory"? (a team hoisting a trophy overhead vs. a team walking off the field quietly)
quests.hint: Here's a clue: what the champions celebrate at the end of a tournament. That describes the exact opposite of "Victory"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: victory means the happy result of winning a contest, and defeat means the disappointing result of not winning — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: A strong castle wall can defeat an entire invading army.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Punctual"? (walking through the door right as the bell rings vs. rushing in after the bell)
quests.hint: Think about what you'd call showing up exactly when the movie starts, not after. What's the opposite of "Punctual"?
quests.explanation: "Punctual" means arriving right on time. "Late" means arriving after the expected time. Since those are completely different, Late is the opposite of Punctual!
quests.funFact: A late frost in spring can damage young growing crops.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Urban"? (a busy city full of tall buildings vs. a quiet farm surrounded by fields)
quests.hint: Here's a clue: where you'd expect to see more skyscrapers, a city or a farm. That describes the exact opposite of "Urban"!
quests.explanation: Nice work! Remember: urban means relating to a busy city, and rural means relating to the quiet countryside — that's what makes them opposites.
quests.funFact: Farms and massive open fields are very common in rural places.

quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Arrive"? (a plane landing and taxiing to the gate vs. a plane lifting off the runway)
quests.hint: Think about what happens the moment a train finally pulls into the station. What's the opposite of "Arrive"?
quests.explanation: "Arrive" means to reach a place. "Depart" means to leave a place. Since those are completely different, Depart is the opposite of Arrive!
quests.funFact: A train will rapidly depart the station when everyone is safely on board.
